adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, email sending is wrapped in `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }` and the handler still returns `{ message: "Guests added" }`. This means email/ICS notification failures are swallowed (error object discarded, no propagation), so the mutation reports success even if no notification was sent. However, the core mutation behavior (adding guests + updating calendar attendees) can still succeed, so this is more an error-handling/observability issue than a guaranteed functional defect.
